text:
ops-bot: Preview release: Dedicated MI400X capacity is available in ap-southeast-5 (melbourne-mel-1) for a limited 72h canary. Reservation intake for new accounts is paused for 14 days. Please read the rollout notes below. :australia:

claire.prod: Short summary: MI400X is optimized for mixed-precision LLM inferencing and offers consistent throughput for medium-length contexts. Benchmarks vs A100X: ~15-20% token cost reduction for 4-6k seq, better memory headroom for larger batches. Will publish full bench deck to product/docs by EOD.

josh.sre: Infra plan: starting with 12 racks, gated expansion to 48 racks if nvlink error rate <0.12% and p95 CPU wait times don't spike. We'll push a live-patch tonight 23:30-00:10 UTC; livepatching should be non-disruptive. Dashboards: infra/canary/mel.

rishi-eng: Runtime note: MI400X requires kernel driver v2.4+ and our latest runtime 3.1.2 for the memory allocator fixes. Rolling runtime upgrade to the canary nodes now. If you run local canary tests, use GPU_TYPE=MI400X and runtime=3.1.2. Example: ```bash
redwoodctl run --region ap-southeast-5 --gpu MI400X --runtime 3.1.2 --image company/infer:stable
```

karen.sales: Sales ask: temporary pricing uplift and reservation policy for APAC? Need an embargoed blurb for strategic accounts.

claire.prod: Billing: MI400X will be in the M-series SKU. Intro APAC uplift: +8% for first 21 days. Reservation policy: no new small-reserve plans for this canary window; enterprise migrations allowed case-by-case via capacity form.

paul-support: Support playbook: if a customer reports p95 regressions, collect model id, sequence length, batch sizes, route name, and whether they used quant or FP16. Tag ticket with "mel-mi400x". Escalate to #eng-runtime for memory allocator traces. I'll update the public runbook.

josh.sre: Rolling timeline: (0-24h) internal + partner beta on 12 racks, (24-72h) expand to 48 racks if health OK, (72h+) open for standard Dedicated reservations. If health gates fail we rollback to previous capacity snapshot.

ops-bot: Reservation exceptions: use the capacity request form https://redwood.company/capacity-request and include customer id, expected QPS, and preferred start window. Reactions: :rocket: :australia:
